title: Induce Stroke via Hypoxia-Ischemia
author: Ian Simpson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8e5htg6

steps.title: Sterilize all equipment
steps.instruction: Autoclave all instrumentation and disposables used for the H/I procedure; for items that cannot be autoclaved, disinfect with MB10.

steps.title: Prepare cages and disinfect
steps.instruction: Wipe cages with MB10, place them in a flow hood, and replace the solid lid with an autoclaved filtered lid.

steps.title: Induce and maintain anesthesia
steps.instruction: Place mice in an induction chamber with 3 % isoflurane in 70 % nitrous oxide/30 % oxygen; confirm depth by loss of toe‑pinch reflex. Transfer to the surgical bench, position the nose in a nosecone, and maintain anesthesia with ~1.5 % isoflurane in the same gas mixture.

steps.title: Prepare surgical site and analgesia
steps.instruction: Shave the neck, scrub with 10 % betadine, rinse with 70 % ethanol, and paint again with 10 % betadine. Inject Bupivacaine locally at 5 mg kg⁻¹ before making the incision.

steps.title: Ligate right carotid artery
steps.instruction: Make a small neck incision, expose the right carotid artery, double‑ligate it with 3‑0 surgical silk, and close the incision with two nylon monofilament sutures.

steps.title: Post‑surgical recovery
steps.instruction: Return the mouse to its cage with food and water and allow it to recover for 3 hours.

steps.title: Sterilize instruments between surgeries
steps.instruction: Place used surgical instruments in a Germinator 500 glass‑bead sterilizer for decontamination before the next operation.

steps.title: Expose mice to hypoxia‑ischemia
steps.instruction: After the 3‑hour recovery, place each mouse in an individual 500 mL glass jar within a closed system water bath set to 35.5 °C (water contains Bacdown). Flow 9 % oxygen balanced with nitrogen for the predetermined insult duration.

steps.title: Post‑insult housing and glucose
steps.instruction: Return mice to their cages, monitor them, then place them on the vent rack for the established recovery period. House mice in pairs, supplement drinking water with 5 % glucose, place food pellets at the cage bottom, and provide a nestlet for enrichment.

steps.title: Collect blood glucose at sacrifice
steps.instruction: Place each mouse in a restrainer, prick the tail with a 25 GA needle, and collect 5 µL of blood into a glucometer cuvette for glucose measurement.

steps.title: Anesthetize for perfusion
steps.instruction: Inject intraperitoneally a cocktail of ketamine (80–100 mg kg⁻¹) and xylazine (10 mg kg⁻¹); confirm surgical plane by loss of toe‑pinch reflex before immobilizing the mouse on a flat surface.

steps.title: Perfuse mouse and collect blood
steps.instruction: Make a lower‑abdominal incision to the xyphoid process, add lateral incisions toward the left and right arms, clamp the rib cage back over the head, and snip the descending aorta below the diaphragm to collect serum/plasma. Insert a feeding tube through a left‑ventricle incision up to the ascending aorta, clamp the aorta and tube below the bulb, cut the right atrium, and perfuse with 30 mL of 1× PBS at 3.3 mL min⁻¹.

steps.title: Remove brain and freeze
steps.instruction: Extract the brain, immerse it in isopentane maintained at 38 °C on dry ice until bubbling subsides, wrap in labeled foil, store on dry ice, then transfer to –80 °C for later cryosectioning. (Alternatively, place the fresh brain in a mold for TTC staining.)

steps.title: Section brain for analysis
steps.instruction: Cut 16 µm sections from fresh‑frozen or perfused brains and mount consecutively on Superfrost Plus slides covering caudate putamen, cortex, striatum, hippocampus, and thalamus; store slides at –80 °C. Also cut 50 µm sections of right (ipsilateral) and left (contralateral) hemispheres for mRNA and western‑blot analysis.

steps.title: Hematoxylin‑Eosin staining
steps.instruction: Hydrate slides for 2 min each in 100 %, 95 %, and 70 % ethanol, then 2 × 2 min dH₂O. Fix in 70 % ethanol for 5 min, rinse twice in dH₂O for 2 min each. Stain in freshly filtered hematoxylin for 3 min, rinse in running tap water for 10 min. Dip twice in eosin, then rinse through several changes of 70 % ethanol until clear. Dehydrate in 95 % ethanol (2 × 2 min), 100 % ethanol (2 × 2 min), and xylene (3 × 2 min). Cover‑slip with a xylene‑based mounting medium.

steps.title: TTC staining of brain sections
steps.instruction: Place the brain in a slicer mold on ice, cut 2 mm thick sections with razor blades, and transfer each section to a well of a 24‑well plate containing 500 µL of 2 % TTC in 0.1 M PBS. Wrap the plate in foil and incubate on a 37 °C slide warmer for 30 min. Remove TTC and add 500 µL fixative to each well for storage. Capture images with an Olympus S2H10 stereo microscope and analyze infarct and total hemispheric areas using Scion image software; calculate percent infarct as ipsilateral area relative to contralateral.
